title: Portuguese Language Specialist
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Portuguese Language Specialist em lauro de freitas. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Position Overview:

As a Gen AI Data Annotation Analyst, you will play a critical role in developing high-quality datasets that power the next generation of Large Language Models (LLMs). You will evaluate, generate, and refine multi-modal data (text, image, or video) to ensure AI outputs are accurate, safe, and culturally resonant for the Portuguese market.


Key Responsibilities

  • Multi-Modal Annotation: Label and categorize high-quality training data across text, image, and video formats with surgical precision.
  • Content Generation: Draft grammatically flawless, creative, and factually accurate text in both Portuguese and English, adapting tone and style for specific project needs.
  • Edge-Case Resolution: Apply logical reasoning to resolve ambiguous data scenarios where guidelines may not explicitly cover a specific nuance.
  • Continuous Feedback: Identify and report bugs within internal annotation tools and suggest workflow optimizations.
  • Cross-Functional Sync: Collaborate with Leads and Project Managers to calibrate on quality benchmarks and project pivots.

System Requirements (Mandatory):

Full set of desktop/Laptop with Windows 11 Pro. Bring a compliant device. Windows 11 Pro (Home editions not allowed) or macOS 12+, 8 GB RAM, 50 GB free disk. Tablets/Chromebooks/phones won’t be accepted.

  • Network: Stable Internet connection, which should have a speed of up to 40MBPS


Requirements:

  • Bachelor's degree/ diploma or equivalent educational qualification.
  • Minimum of 1-2 years of experience in annotation tasks, linguistic data handling, or related AI/ML projects.
  • Demonstrated experience working with data annotation tools and software platforms.
  • Strong understanding of language nuances, including grammar, style, and cultural context.
  • Ability to adapt quickly to changing project directions and fast-paced work environments.
  • Previous experience creating or annotating complex data specifically for Large Language Model (LLM) training.
  • Familiarity with annotation projects involving sensitive or nuanced content.
  • Prior exposure to Generative AI technologies and principles.


What We Offer:

  • An innovative and supportive global working environment.
  • Opportunities for continuous learning and growth.
  • Competitive compensation and remote working arrangements.
  • Engagement in impactful projects at the forefront of AI technology.


Join iMerit to be part of shaping high-quality datasets powering the next generation of

Generative AI solutions. If precision, critical analysis, and innovation excite you, we encourage

you to apply!

title: Senior Software Engineer (Full Stack)
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Senior Software Engineer (Full Stack) em salvador. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Senior Software Engineer (Full Stack)


Location: Remote

Contract: PJ (Long-Term)


About the Opportunity

We are seeking a kind, curious, and highly collaborative Senior Software Engineer (Full Stack) who enjoys solving complex technical challenges and building exceptional user experiences.

This team is responsible for creating seamless and compelling digital experiences that make it easy for customers to engage with a premium e-commerce and consignment platform. The engineering culture emphasizes collaboration, continuous learning, individual growth, and professional development.

As a Senior Software Engineer, you will be both a hands-on technical contributor and a key influencer in shaping engineering direction. You will lead and contribute to significant initiatives, mentor fellow engineers through code reviews and pair programming, and help drive the evolution of a modern technology platform.

This opportunity is ideal for engineers passionate about luxury retail, e-commerce, sustainability, and circular economy business models.


What You'll Do

  • Design, develop, and maintain high-quality, scalable, performant, and testable software solutions.
  • Build and enhance customer-facing applications that directly support strategic business initiatives.
  • Contribute to technical architecture and engineering decisions that shape the future of the platform.
  • Collaborate closely with product managers, designers, and engineers to deliver impactful features.
  • Review pull requests and provide thoughtful, constructive feedback to teammates.
  • Participate in pair programming and knowledge-sharing activities across the team.
  • Deploy production-ready code and support applications throughout the software development lifecycle.
  • Continuously learn and explore new technologies, design patterns, and engineering practices.


Technology Stack

You will have the opportunity to work with a modern technology stack including:

  • Java
  • Kotlin
  • JavaScript
  • TypeScript
  • GraphQL
  • Kafka
  • AWS Lambda
  • PostgreSQL
  • DynamoDB

Legacy services currently include:

  • Ruby on Rails
  • Elixir
  • React


Required Experience & Skills

  • 7+ years of professional software development experience.
  • Strong proficiency in Java or Kotlin, along with experience working in Ruby on Rails environments.
  • Expertise in modern JavaScript (ECMAScript), HTML, and CSS.
  • Experience building applications with React and related ecosystem tools, including Node.js and npm.
  • Familiarity with RESTful APIs, Git, TypeScript, IDEs, version control systems, and deployment tools.
  • Understanding of event-driven architectures, GraphQL, and database design fundamentals.
  • Strong problem-solving skills and a user-centric engineering mindset.
  • Interest in retail, e-commerce, luxury consignment, sustainability, or circular economy business models.


Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience implementing or maintaining Kafka-based event streaming solutions.
  • Experience working with Elixir.
  • Experience decomposing monolithic applications into microservices.

title: Video Production Operations Lead - Brazil
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Video Production Operations Lead - Brazil em feira de santana. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

About Us


Pocket FM is the world’s largest audio-series platform, where powerful stories travel effortlessly across languages, cultures, and continents. From India and the US to Europe and beyond, we are redefining how stories are created, discovered, and experienced across the globe, without screens.


At our core, we are an AI-powered entertainment company with a deeply human-first philosophy. We believe technology should amplify creativity. Our proprietary AI systems work alongside writers, voice artists, and creative teams to help stories scale globally, faster, smarter, and with cultural depth and emotional integrity intact.


Today, Pocket FM is home to a vibrant community of 250+ million listeners, 300,000+ creators, and 100,000+ audio series. With over 140 billion minutes streamed annually, we have emerged as one of the fastest-growing media-tech companies in the world, and we are just getting started. We operate at a massive global scale, but with a startup mindset: curious, fast-moving, and deeply owner-driven. At Pocket FM, teams are encouraged to think boldly, move with intent, and build for long-term impact as we shape the future of audio-first storytelling worldwide.


Role Overview


As the Team Lead for Portuguese Sketches, you oversee the end-to-end production workflow, ensuring high-quality, scalable, and timely delivery of localized content. You lead a cross-functional team and ensure alignment between English and Portuguese Sketches while maintaining strict audio, visual, and subtitle quality standards.


In addition to overseeing production workflow, this role functions as a key operational stabilizer within the Portuguese content ecosystem. The Team lead ensures asset readiness, prevents production bottlenecks, bridges cross-time-zone collaboration, and safeguards content integrity across localized adaptations, enabling consistent and reliable execution at scale.


Key Responsibilities


Leadership & Workflow Management


  • Team Leadership & Workflow Management: Assign daily tasks, prioritize deliverables, and ensure smooth coordination across Video Editors and QC Specialists.


  • Production Continuity Ownership: Ensure editors are never blocked due to missing assets, incomplete folders, or lack of resource preparation. Proactively prepare videos, audios, scripts, and subtitles before daily production begins.


  • Cross-Team Asset Coordination: Act as liaison between Spanish/Portugeuse production, US content teams, and India stakeholders to request, follow up, and secure required assets in a timely manner.


  • Process Standardization: Develop and maintain internal documentation (SOPs, transition guides, tracking frameworks) to support workflow clarity, team alignment, and smooth leadership transitions.



Reporting, Assets & Documentation


  • Reporting & Performance Tracking: Submit daily performance reports and monitor output, quality, and timelines.


  • Asset & Process Management: Oversee asset organization, repository accuracy, and workflow improvements to enhance efficiency and scalability.


  • Repository & Documentation Management : Maintain structured asset repositories, matching sheets, and tracking documents to ensure transparency and avoid duplication, inconsistencies, or production gaps.


Quality & Content Oversight


  • Quality Oversight: Ensure full synchronization between visuals, audio, and subtitles; consistent visual style; complete audio mix (vocals, music, SFX); and no unintended logos or asset errors.
  • English–Portuguese Alignment: Maintain narrative and visual coherence between source and localized content.
  • Content Integrity Assurance: Monitor alignment between English source content and Portuguese localized assets across motion episodes, still episodes, promo videos, and thumbnails to ensure narrative coherence and platform consistency.


Operations & Issue Resolution


  • Technical Issue Resolution: Address audio/video sync issues, asset inconsistencies, and day-to-day production challenges.


  • Daily Operational Troubleshooting: Resolve audio inconsistencies, subtitle mismatches, CMS issues, visual discrepancies, and asset errors to maintain high production standards.


Reporting, Assets & Documentation


  • Reporting & Performance Tracking: Submit daily performance reports and monitor output, quality, and timelines.


  • Asset & Process Management: Oversee asset organization, repository accuracy, and workflow improvements to enhance efficiency and scalability.


  • Repository & Documentation Management: Maintain structured asset repositories, matching sheets, and tracking documents to ensure transparency and avoid duplication, inconsistencies, or production gaps.


Operations & Issue Resolution


  • Technical Issue Resolution: Address audio/video sync issues, asset inconsistencies, and day-to-day production challenges.
  • Daily Operational Troubleshooting: Resolve audio inconsistencies, subtitle mismatches, CMS issues, visual discrepancies, and asset errors to maintain high production standards.
  • Risk Prevention & Escalation: Identify operational risks (delays, inconsistencies, technical issues) early and escalate proactively to prevent impact on timelines and overall production output.



Qualifications


  • Bachelor’s degree in Audio Production, Linguistics, Media, or a related field.
  • Intermediate to advanced English proficiency, with advanced knowledge of Portuguese grammar and orthography.
  • Proven experience in quality control, audio/video production, or a related content operations role.
  • Proficiency in Adobe Suite (including Premiere); familiarity with CMS platforms required. Experience reviewing AI-generated content is a plus.
  • Strong attention to detail with a critical eye for audiovisual quality and consistency.
  • Demonstrated leadership and team management experience.
  • Excellent organizational, prioritization, and time management skills.
  • Strong problem-solving abilities with a proactive, solution-oriented mindset.
  • Demonstrated ability to act as operational backbone in high-volume content environments, ensuring production continuity and workflow stability.
  • Proven experience anticipating production risks (asset gaps, sync inconsistencies, narrative misalignment) and implementing preventive solutions before escalation.
  • Strong cross-cultural communication skills, with experience bridging expectations between international stakeholders (e.g., US and India teams) and local production teams.
  • Experience building structured documentation, repositories, and tracking systems that enhance team clarity and reduce operational friction.
  • Ability to maintain narrative and technical coherence despite creative divergence across markets.
  • High level of ownership and accountability over end-to-end production outcomes.
  • Strategic operational mindset with the ability to balance creative integrity, technical precision, and workflow efficiency.


Language requirements

  • Fluent Portugese
  • Professional working proficiency in English


This role will be working with stakeholders in English on a regular basis.


Salary for this position is R$7,000 - $10,000 BRL.

description:

Role: Senior Salesforce & AWS Developer

Location: Remote (Brazil)

Duration: Multi-year engagement


Position Overview

Insight Global is seeking multiple Senior Salesforce & AWS Developers to support a large-scale healthcare client (Sevita). This is a highly technical, hands-on role within a custom, enterprise environment where Salesforce serves as the system of record and AWS powers complex data processing and integrations.

The team is looking for proven, senior-level developers who can contribute immediately, own enhancements, and operate across both Salesforce and AWS ecosystems with minimal ramp-up.


Key Responsibilities

  • Design, develop, and enhance Salesforce applications using Apex, Lightning, and custom components
  • Build and maintain AWS-based services for data extraction, transformation, and distribution
  • Integrate Salesforce with AWS services and downstream systems via REST APIs
  • Support data flows to external partners, mobile applications, and state systems
  • Own performance tuning, enhancements, and production support across platforms
  • Contribute to CI/CD pipelines, deployments, and release management
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams in a highly customized, homegrown environment
  • Troubleshoot and resolve complex system and integration issues


Required Qualifications

  • 5–7+ years of hands-on Salesforce development experience
  • Strong Salesforce expertise across:
  • Apex, LWC, Visualforce, Aura
  • SOQL, SOSL
  • Flows, triggers, controllers, Lightning Apps
  • Experience with custom objects, validation rules, workflows, reports, dashboards
  • Experience with SFDX, deployments, and Salesforce administration tasks
  • Strong experience with AWS development
  • Proficiency in:
  • Node.js, Lambda, API Gateway
  • SNS, SQS, IAM, Secrets Manager
  • S3, DynamoDB, RDS
  • Route 53 and networking fundamentals
  • Strong experience with REST API integrations
  • Experience with CI/CD, build & deployment processes, and application security
  • Understanding of AWS architecture (regions, availability zones, monitoring tools )
  • Experience with CloudFormation and SAM deployments
  • Ability to support large, complex enterprise systems across multiple projects


Preferred Qualifications

  • Exposure to Amplify or modern AWS full-stack tooling
  • Familiarity with EventBridge or event-driven architectures
  • Experience with automation or scripting (Groovy, CLI tools, etc.)
  • Exposure to Salesforce Data Cloud / Data 360


What Success Looks Like

  • Immediate contribution to ongoing development and enhancements
  • Reliable and scalable Salesforce + AWS integrations
  • High-quality, secure, and performant application delivery
  • Strong ownership of production issues and system improvements
  • Ability to operate effectively in a fast-paced, highly customized environment


Ideal Candidate Profile

  • Senior, highly hands-on developer with deep Salesforce expertise

  • Proven ability to ramp quickly and deliver impact immediately
  • Detail-oriented and technically credible (must be fully vetted/verified candidates)

Leadership & Workflow Management

Quality & Content Oversight

  • Content Integrity Assurance: Monitor alignment between English source content and Portuguese localized assets across motion episodes, still episodes, promo videos, and thumbnails to ensure narrative coherence and platform consistency.


Operations & Issue Resolution


  • Technical Issue Resolution: Address audio/video sync issues, asset inconsistencies, and day-to-day production challenges.


  • Daily Operational Troubleshooting: Resolve audio inconsistencies, subtitle mismatches, CMS issues, visual discrepancies, and asset errors to maintain high production standards.


Reporting, Assets & Documentation


  • Reporting & Performance Tracking: Submit daily performance reports and monitor output, quality, and timelines.


  • Asset & Process Management: Oversee asset organization, repository accuracy, and workflow improvements to enhance efficiency and scalability.


  • Repository & Documentation Management: Maintain structured asset repositories, matching sheets, and tracking documents to ensure transparency and avoid duplication, inconsistencies, or production gaps.


Operations & Issue Resolution


  • Technical Issue Resolution: Address audio/video sync issues, asset inconsistencies, and day-to-day production challenges.
  • Daily Operational Troubleshooting: Resolve audio inconsistencies, subtitle mismatches, CMS issues, visual discrepancies, and asset errors to maintain high production standards.
  • Risk Prevention & Escalation: Identify operational risks (delays, inconsistencies, technical issues) early and escalate proactively to prevent impact on timelines and overall production output.



Qualifications


  • Bachelor’s degree in Audio Production, Linguistics, Media, or a related field.
  • Intermediate to advanced English proficiency, with advanced knowledge of Portuguese grammar and orthography.
  • Proven experience in quality control, audio/video production, or a related content operations role.
  • Proficiency in Adobe Suite (including Premiere); familiarity with CMS platforms required. Experience reviewing AI-generated content is a plus.
  • Strong attention to detail with a critical eye for audiovisual quality and consistency.
  • Demonstrated leadership and team management experience.
  • Excellent organizational, prioritization, and time management skills.
  • Strong problem-solving abilities with a proactive, solution-oriented mindset.
  • Demonstrated ability to act as operational backbone in high-volume content environments, ensuring production continuity and workflow stability.
  • Proven experience anticipating production risks (asset gaps, sync inconsistencies, narrative misalignment) and implementing preventive solutions before escalation.
  • Strong cross-cultural communication skills, with experience bridging expectations between international stakeholders (e.g., US and India teams) and local production teams.
  • Experience building structured documentation, repositories, and tracking systems that enhance team clarity and reduce operational friction.
  • Ability to maintain narrative and technical coherence despite creative divergence across markets.

  • Strategic operational mindset with the ability to balance creative integrity, technical precision, and workflow efficiency.

Senior Software Engineer (Full Stack)


Location: Remote

Contract: PJ (Long-Term)


About the Opportunity

We are seeking a kind, curious, and highly collaborative Senior Software Engineer (Full Stack) who enjoys solving complex technical challenges and building exceptional user experiences.

This team is responsible for creating seamless and compelling digital experiences that make it easy for customers to engage with a premium e-commerce and consignment platform. The engineering culture emphasizes collaboration, continuous learning, individual growth, and professional development.

As a Senior Software Engineer, you will be both a hands-on technical contributor and a key influencer in shaping engineering direction. You will lead and contribute to significant initiatives, mentor fellow engineers through code reviews and pair programming, and help drive the evolution of a modern technology platform.

This opportunity is ideal for engineers passionate about luxury retail, e-commerce, sustainability, and circular economy business models.


What You'll Do

  • Design, develop, and maintain high-quality, scalable, performant, and testable software solutions.
  • Build and enhance customer-facing applications that directly support strategic business initiatives.
  • Contribute to technical architecture and engineering decisions that shape the future of the platform.
  • Collaborate closely with product managers, designers, and engineers to deliver impactful features.
  • Review pull requests and provide thoughtful, constructive feedback to teammates.
  • Participate in pair programming and knowledge-sharing activities across the team.
  • Deploy production-ready code and support applications throughout the software development lifecycle.
  • Continuously learn and explore new technologies, design patterns, and engineering practices.


Technology Stack

You will have the opportunity to work with a modern technology stack including:

  • Java
  • Kotlin
  • JavaScript
  • TypeScript
  • GraphQL
  • Kafka
  • AWS Lambda
  • PostgreSQL
  • DynamoDB

Legacy services currently include:

  • Ruby on Rails
  • Elixir
  • React


Required Experience & Skills

  • 7+ years of professional software development experience.
  • Strong proficiency in Java or Kotlin, along with experience working in Ruby on Rails environments.
  • Expertise in modern JavaScript (ECMAScript), HTML, and CSS.
  • Experience building applications with React and related ecosystem tools, including Node.js and npm.
  • Familiarity with RESTful APIs, Git, TypeScript, IDEs, version control systems, and deployment tools.
  • Understanding of event-driven architectures, GraphQL, and database design fundamentals.
  • Strong problem-solving skills and a user-centric engineering mindset.
  • Interest in retail, e-commerce, luxury consignment, sustainability, or circular economy business models.


Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience implementing or maintaining Kafka-based event streaming solutions.
  • Experience working with Elixir.
  • Experience decomposing monolithic applications into microservices.
  • Familiarity with distributed systems and service-oriented architectures.


What Makes You Successful

  • You are curious, adaptable, and continuously seek opportunities to learn.
  • You thrive in collaborative environments and enjoy mentoring fellow engineers.
  • You balance technical excellence with pragmatic decision-making.
  • You care deeply about delivering value to users through technology.
  • You are excited by the opportunity to contribute to a mission-driven organization focused on sustainability and premium resale experiences.

title: AI Developer
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para AI Developer em salvador. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

We're partnering with a global software organization that is investing heavily in AI-driven products, automation, and intelligent workflow solutions. This is an opportunity to join a growing AI & Automation team focused on building real-world applications that deliver measurable business value. The team is moving beyond experimentation and proof-of-concepts into production-grade systems used by customers and internal stakeholders.


About the Role

If you're a software engineer who uses AI to build better software, not someone who simply prompts AI tools, this could be a strong fit.


Responsibilities

  • Design, develop, and deploy production-ready software solutions
  • Build AI-enabled applications and automation workflows
  • Evaluate and implement new technologies through rapid prototyping and proof-of-concept development
  • Collaborate with engineering and business teams to deliver scalable solutions
  • Contribute to architecture decisions, coding standards, and technical best practices
  • Integrate AI services, APIs, and automation platforms into business applications
  • Help drive the adoption of modern software development practices, including AI-assisted development


Qualifications

  • 5+ years of software engineering experience


Required Skills

  • Strong software design and problem-solving skills
  • Experience building and supporting production applications
  • Hands-on experience with AI-assisted development tools
  • Experience with workflow automation and process orchestration
  • Strong understanding of APIs, integrations, and modern application architectures
  • Ability to learn new technologies quickly and work across multiple projects


Technical Environment

Experience in several of the following areas is preferred:

  • .NET/ C#
  • Node.js
  • React
  • JavaScript / TypeScript
  • PostgreSQL
  • MongoDB or document databases
  • REST APIs
  • Cloud platforms (Azure or AWS)
  • AI integrations and automation platforms
  • Claude
  • CodeRAG (Retrieval Augmented Generation)
  • n8n or similar workflow automation tools

What Makes Someone Successful Here

This team is looking for engineers who:

  • Can take a concept from idea to production
  • Know when AI-generated code is useful and when it needs refinement
  • Understand software engineering fundamentals beyond prompting tools
  • Enjoy solving business problems through automation
  • Thrive in environments where new technologies are evaluated and adopted quickly

What This Role Is Not

This is not a machine learning research position. This is not a prompt engineering role. This is a hands-on software engineering position focused on building production applications that leverage AI and automation technologies.


Why Consider This Opportunity?

  • Work on AI-enabled products that are actively being deployed
  • Join a team focused on innovation and delivery
  • Exposure to modern AI, automation, and software development practices


Fully remote within Brazil

This is a CLT Role - Compensation is R$15,000/month

title: Account Manager
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Account Manager em lauro de freitas. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

We're hiring account managers who'd rather grow a customer than keep one.


R$181,130 to R$524,000 CAD | Remote Brazil | Unlimited PTO


WeTransact is looking for an Account Manager to join our growing team.


Your Mission

  • Own the account after go-live : You're the customer's main point of contact once they're live and transactable, and you're accountable for their revenue growth on the marketplace.
  • Advise on the right path : You assess where each ISV is and recommend the program or plan that moves them forward, from IP Co-sell eligibility to Certified Software status to new channels.
  • Drive adoption into revenue : You implement the work that converts a live listing into transactions: CRM integration, Crossbeam setup, sales comp parity, and Microsoft incentives.
  • Challenge the customer : When results aren't there, you challenge their structure and bring them a revised plan rather than a status update.
  • Navigating the Microsoft Field : You connect customers to the right AEs and PDMs and build the co-sell motion that moves deals.
  • Compounding with AI : AI is part of your daily workflow across research, QBR prep, and pipeline. This isn't a perk we offer, it's how we operate.


What We're Looking For

  • +4 years in sales at a B2B tech company. Quota-carrying, with a track record of growing accounts. CSM or account management background is a plus, not a substitute.
  • You think in revenue. Adoption is the means, not the metric.
  • English fluent. You present to Customer or Microsoft stakeholders in English without prep.
  • Daily, instinctive use of AI tools.
  • Comfortable being the one who tells a customer their approach isn't working — and what to do instead.
  • You manage 30+ accounts without dropping the ball.


What You Get

  • Unlimited PTO.
  • AI-first culture across the business.
  • Direct access to Microsoft teams and the partner ecosystem most companies spend years trying to reach.
  • Real ownership of a revenue book, measured in outcomes not activity.
  • Path to senior measured in quarters, not years.
  • Global team in more than 12 countries with a strong culture.


About WeTransact

Most companies in our space raise tens of millions and burn it chasing this market. We bootstrapped, turned a profit, and built the software that 500+ companies now use to sell through Microsoft. Titles don't matter here. Accountability does, and so does winning as a team.

title: Site Reliability Engineer
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Site Reliability Engineer em salvador. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Job Title: Site Reliability Engineer (SRE) / Infrastructure Operations MID LEVEL


Role Overview

Responsible for managing day-to-day infrastructure operations, including monitoring, alerting, and driving stability improvements across the environment.


Key Responsibilities

  • Monitor overall infrastructure health and system performance
  • Track key performance metrics such as CPU, memory, and disk utilization
  • Tune alerts to improve signal-to-noise ratio and reduce alert fatigue
  • Support disaster recovery (DR) rehearsals and readiness activities
  • Maintain and update runbooks, documentation, and operational reports


Required Experience

  • 4–6 years of experience in Site Reliability Engineering (SRE) or infrastructure operations
  • Hands-on experience with VMware environments
  • Experience with monitoring tools such as PRTG, Datadog, or similar platforms
  • Strong incident management experience, including response and resolution processes


Core Skills & Competencies

  • Solid understanding of infrastructure performance metrics (CPU, memory, disk, etc.)
  • Experience with alert tuning and optimization
  • Ability to proactively detect and troubleshoot performance issues
  • Strong incident management and operational response capabilities


Screening Signals

Look for candidates who:

  • Understand CPU Ready thresholds and their impact on performance
  • Have hands-on experience tuning alerts to reduce noise
  • Can proactively identify and resolve performance bottlenecks
  • Demonstrate strong incident management experience in production environments

title: Senior .Net Engineer (WFH)
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Senior .Net Engineer (WFH) em lauro de freitas. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Senior .Net Engineer


Resume: English Version only. Resume should have detailed discussion of project overview and job description. Highlight the following if applicable - Maui (Blazor, Razor, Xamarin); Healthcare projects; HIPAA knowledge; SAAS projects; US-based projects

Role: Full time contractor; Fully Remote

Work Hours : US time zone

Location: Brazil

Rate: R$20,000-22,000 per month


About the Company

We are a forward-thinking technology organization dedicated to developing innovative software solutions that improve outcomes for clients and end-users. Our engineering team designs, builds, and maintains scalable, high-quality applications that drive efficiency and innovation across industries. We are seeking an experienced Level III Software Engineer (contractor) to join our distributed team, contributing to complex projects with a focus on code quality, security, and collaboration.


Position Overview

As a Level III Software Engineer (contractor), you will apply your technical expertise to deliver high-quality code for moderately to highly complex projects. Working remotely with a U.S.-based team, you'll gain deep system knowledge and contribute to an Agile development workflow using Azure DevOps.

You will begin with automated testing and peer reviews, expanding into broader development tasks by months 2–3. The role will continue to evolve based on your strengths and project needs, while maintaining rigorous adherence to coding and security standards.


Key Responsibilities

  • Product Design & Development: Collaborate with stakeholders to design and implement software solutions aligned with technical and business objectives.
  • Code Contributions: Write, optimize, and maintain efficient code, including enhancement of existing codebases, beginning around months 3–4.
  • Testing & Quality: Design and implement automated end-to-end (E2E) tests (e.g., using Microsoft Playwright) to ensure feature stability—especially during the first 6–9 months.
  • Peer Reviews: Participate in pre-release feature reviews and early post-release bug analysis (first 90 days), transitioning to broader ownership over time.
  • Agile Workflow Participation: Actively contribute to sprints, pull requests, and releases within a 2-week sprint / 6-week release cycle using Azure DevOps.
  • Collaboration: Communicate effectively with both technical and non-technical team members across multiple time zones.


Qualifications


Experience

  • 5–8 years of software engineering experience with a demonstrated record of success on complex projects.


Technical Skills

  • Proficiency in C# ASP.NET (.NET 8) for web applications and APIs.
  • Experience with .NET MAUI and Blazor Web Applications (.NET 8) , leveraging web expertise for cross-platform or mobile development.
  • Familiarity with Microsoft Azure services, including Azure App Service, Azure SQL, and Azure Storage.
  • Strong understanding of modern development tools (e.g., Visual Studio, Git, Azure DevOps).
  • Knowledge of secure coding practices and general cybersecurity principles.
  • Experience with cloud platforms and Agile methodologies .


Soft Skills

  • Excellent problem-solving and analytical abilities.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills for remote collaboration.
  • Ability to work independently and within a collaborative team environment.


Preferred

  • Experience with regulated or data-sensitive software environments (e.g., healthcare, financial services, HIPAA, PHI).
  • Prior experience conducting pull-request reviews and participating in Agile sprints.


What We Offer

  • Opportunity to work on impactful, large-scale technology projects.
  • Collaborative, high-performance engineering culture focused on quality and innovation.
  • Flexible remote work environment with a structured onboarding process for success.


How We Work

  • Agile Workflow: Two-week sprints within a six-week release cycle, including daily stand-ups (3:00 PM CT), sprint planning, and reviews.
  • Code Standards: Strict adherence to best practices, peer reviews, and security testing (e.g., OWASP, Detectify).
  • Tool Stack: Azure DevOps, Visual Studio, SQL Server Management Studio, Datadog, Microsoft Playwright, and related technologies.
  • Team Culture: A focus on accountability, collaboration, and excellence in delivery.

title: Senior Warehouse Automation Specialist
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Senior Warehouse Automation Specialist em camaçari. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Location: Brazil/Remote

Contract: Permanent / Freelance

Experience Level: Senior

Language: English and Portuguese



Mission Overview

We are looking for a Senior Warehouse Automation Specialist to lead the design, implementation, and optimization of advanced automation solutions within distribution and logistics environments.

You will act as a key System Engineer , bridging operational needs with cutting-edge technologies such as robotics, RTLS (Real-Time Locating Systems), and machine vision systems to drive efficiency, accuracy, and scalability.

This role is ideal for someone who thrives in complex environments and enjoys combining technical expertise, data analysis, and project leadership to transform warehouse operations.


Key Responsibilities

System Design & Implementation

  • Design and deploy automated warehouse systems (AS/RS, conveyors, AGVs, robotic picking solutions)
  • Integrate RTLS solutions for real-time tracking of assets and inventory
  • Lead end-to-end system architecture aligned with operational requirements

Technical Optimization & Performance

  • Analyze workflows and system performance to identify bottlenecks
  • Implement data-driven improvements to maximize throughput and efficiency
  • Optimize warehouse execution systems (WES), warehouse management systems (WMS), and automation tools

Maintenance & Troubleshooting

  • Monitor and ensure high availability of automation systems (robotics, sensors, vision systems)
  • Diagnose and resolve system issues across hardware and software layers
  • Maintain system documentation and continuous improvement processes

Project Management & Delivery

  • Lead or contribute to automation projects from concept to deployment
  • Coordinate with cross-functional teams (operations, IT, engineering)
  • Ensure minimal disruption to live operations during implementation

Training & Change Management

  • Support operational teams in adopting new technologies
  • Provide training and documentation for system usage and best practices

Safety & Compliance

  • Ensure all systems comply with safety standards and industry regulations
  • Contribute to improving workplace safety and ergonomics


Required Qualifications

  • 7+ years of experience in warehouse automation, system engineering, or industrial automation
  • Proven experience with RTLS (Real-Time Locating Systems)
  • Strong background in machine vision systems
  • Hands-on experience with:
  • WMS / WES systems
  • Robotics, AGVs, or automated material handling systems
  • Solid understanding of electro-mechanical systems, sensors, and control systems
  • Willingness and ability to travel regularly (nationally and/or internationally) to support project deployments and client sites


Nice to Have

  • Experience in project management (PMP or equivalent is a plus)
  • Knowledge of programming/scripting (Python or similar)
  • Experience with data analysis and performance optimization
  • Background in industrial engineering, robotics, or logistics systems
  • Portuguese knowledge


Key Skills

  • Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities
  • System-level thinking and architecture mindset
  • Ability to work in complex, fast-paced environments
  • Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills

  • Prefered Setup: Established as an Independent Contractor with a registered PJ entity in Brazil.
  • Autonomy: Comfortable working remotely and asynchronously with our Global HQ.

title: Senior Software Engineer (Go)
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Senior Software Engineer (Go) em lauro de freitas. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Together with the Zoolatech team, our partner, a leading construction management company, is at the forefront of developing a cloud-based software solution. This innovative platform is instrumental in the successful completion of major projects including skyscrapers, hospitals, data centers, stadiums, and schools. It streamlines the management of finances, quality, teams, and risks, making these processes transparent, convenient, and regulation-compliant. Our partner is not only an expert in construction management but also a significant technology innovator, actively developing web and mobile solutions.


Currently Directory business unit owns user identity and access management across their entire platform ecosystem. They've just launched a brand-new Go-based service into closed beta — a ground-up rebuild of how users and companies are managed across the platform. It's live, but not yet actively used. The work ahead is substantial: migrating data and business logic out of a Ruby monolith, building new features in parallel, and accelerating the service toward full production ownership. Now we are looking for reinforcement for the team to develop the new service and help with the migration from the legacy platform.


Responsibilities

  • Build and maintain backend services in Go, implementing event-driven systems governed by CQRS and event sourcing patterns
  • Drive migration of business logic and data from the Ruby legacy monolith into the new Go service
  • Contribute to the new service while it moves from closed beta toward becoming authoritative — building ongoing features in parallel with migration
  • Develop and extend GraphQL Federation schemas that power the federated API gateway
  • Partner with Engineering, Product, and UX to design and build solutions that address user and company management challenges
  • Use a systems engineering approach to make technical design decisions that improve scalability, performance, and reliability
  • Write highly performant code that supports a distributed, multi-tenant SaaS architecture
  • Conduct code reviews, provide mentorship, and actively drive engineering excellence across the team
  • Communicate complex technical problems and solutions clearly to both technical and non-technical stakeholders


Skills Required

  • 5+ years in Software Engineering across full-stack distributed applications
  • 3+ years of hands-on Go in production microservices
  • Experience with CQRS and event sourcing patterns
  • Experience with Kafka or similar distributed event streaming platforms
  • Experience with PostgreSQL, including data modeling and query optimization
  • Familiarity with GraphQL, including schema design
  • Working knowledge of React and TypeScript for frontend contributions
  • Comfort working across the full development lifecycle: design, testing, staging, deployment, monitoring
  • Strong communication skills — ability to collaborate across US and international time zones
  • US time zone or compatible overlap (EST/CST);

Would be a huge plus:

  • Experience with Ruby/Rails systems, including incremental refactoring and modernization


Engagement Model: Direct Independent Contractor (Please read carefully)


This is an independent contractor opportunity based on a direct contractual relationship between Zoolatech and the individual service provider.


To facilitate this direct partnership, we engage with professionals who are registered and operate as a sole proprietorship, private entrepreneur, or an equivalent self-employment status in your country.


Please note, our model does not accommodate contracts through third-party intermediaries such as agencies, incubators, or umbrella companies. The essential requirement is your ability to enter into a service agreement and invoice Zoolatech directly. This is not an offer of direct employment


Please note that only candidates whose profiles closely match our requirements will be contacted.

Location: Brazil/Remote

Contract: Permanent / Freelance

Experience Level: Senior

Language: English and Portuguese



Mission Overview

We are looking for a Senior Warehouse Automation Specialist to lead the design, implementation, and optimization of advanced automation solutions within distribution and logistics environments.

You will act as a key System Engineer , bridging operational needs with cutting-edge technologies such as robotics, RTLS (Real-Time Locating Systems), and machine vision systems to drive efficiency, accuracy, and scalability.

This role is ideal for someone who thrives in complex environments and enjoys combining technical expertise, data analysis, and project leadership to transform warehouse operations.

System Design & Implementation

  • Design and deploy automated warehouse systems (AS/RS, conveyors, AGVs, robotic picking solutions)
  • Integrate RTLS solutions for real-time tracking of assets and inventory

Technical Optimization & Performance

  • Implement data-driven improvements to maximize throughput and efficiency

Preferred

Experience

Technical Skills

  • Experience with cloud platforms and Agile methodologies .


Soft Skills

  • Excellent problem-solving and analytical abilities.

Preferred

  • Experience with regulated or data-sensitive software environments (e.g., healthcare, financial services, HIPAA, PHI).
  • Prior experience conducting pull-request reviews and participating in Agile sprints.


What We Offer

  • Opportunity to work on impactful, large-scale technology projects.
  • Collaborative, high-performance engineering culture focused on quality and innovation.
  • Flexible remote work environment with a structured onboarding process for success.


How We Work

  • Agile Workflow: Two-week sprints within a six-week release cycle, including daily stand-ups (3:00 PM CT), sprint planning, and reviews.

  • Tool Stack: Azure DevOps, Visual Studio, SQL Server Management Studio, Datadog, Microsoft Playwright, and related technologies.
  • Team Culture: A focus on accountability, collaboration, and excellence in delivery.

title: Online Ad Rater - Remote Work for German Speakers in Brazil
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Online Ad Rater - Remote Work for German Speakers in Brazil em lauro de freitas. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Seeking a freelance project that will allow you to work from home while making a difference in the world of technology? If you are someone who is passionate and enjoys staying ahead of the tech curve this part-time remote project with flexible working hours might be what you are looking for!


A Day in the Life of a Personalized Internet Ads Assessor:

  • In this role, you will be reviewing online advertisements by rating them on their relevance to the search terms used as well as providing feedback on their language and cultural relevance in order to improve their content, quality, and layout
  • Your ultimate goal will be to contribute towards making internet search and online advertising more relevant and interesting for millions of users, including yourself.



Join our team today and start putting your skills to work for one of the world's leading online advertising platforms while being a part of a supportive community that offers:

  • Access to complimentary mental health support benefits like free EAP and Mindfulness Apps.
  • Dedicated, responsive well-being team proactively offering well-being education each month, as well as quarterly initiatives.



TELUS Digital AI Community

Our global AI Community is a vibrant network of 1 million+ contributors from diverse backgrounds who help our customers collect, enhance, train, translate, and localize content to build better AI models. Become part of our growing community and make an impact supporting the machine learning models of some of the world’s largest brands.


Qualification path

No previous professional experience is required to apply to this role, however, working on this project will require you to pass the basic requirements and go through a standard assessment process. This is a part-time long-term project and your work will be subject to our standard quality assurance checks during the term of this agreement.


Basic Requirements

  • Working as a freelancer with excellent communication skills, with full professional proficiency in English and Geman
  • Having familiarity with current and historical business, media, sport, news, social media, and cultural affairs in Brazil
  • Active use of Gmail, Google+, and other forms of social media and experience in the use of web browsers to navigate and interact with a variety of content
  • Daily access to a broadband internet connection, a smartphone (Android 4.1, iOS 8 or higher), and a personal computer with antivirus software to work on. You’ll also need a
  • Barcode Scanner application to be installed on your smartphone to complete certain tasks.
  • English CV
  • This is an explicit human evaluation role. Live task rating requires authentic human judgment, perspective, and evaluation


The estimated hourly earnings for this role is 6 USD. Payment is based on completed tasks, with the potential for higher earnings based on productivity.


Assessment

In order to be hired into the program, you’ll take a language assessment and an open book qualification exam that will determine your suitability for the position and complete ID verification. Don’t worry, our team will provide you with guidelines and learning materials before your exam. You will be required to complete the exam in a specific timeframe but at your convenience!


Equal Opportunity

All qualified applicants will receive consideration for a contractual relationship without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, or protected veteran status. At TELUS Digital AI, we are proud to offer equal opportunities and are committed to creating a diverse and inclusive community. All aspects of selection are based on applicants’ qualifications, merits, competence, and performance without regard to any characteristic related to diversity.

description:

Job Title: Regional Mass Hiring Specialist / BPO Recruiter (Freelance)

Location: Remote, Brazil


Contract Type : Independent Contractor (PJ setup required)


About Thoth AI At Thoth AI, we are building the global data infrastructure that powers the next generation of AI. We require massive amounts of high-quality, localized data (speech, text, image) to train AI models. To achieve this, we are rapidly expanding our crowd-sourcing and freelance network across Latin America.


The Role We need an agile Volume Hiring Specialist and Community Builder . Your primary mission is to build robust, down-to-earth talent pipelines to rapidly fulfill large-scale data collection and annotation projects. If you know how to generate fast candidate traffic and manage micro-vendors in LATAM, this is for you.


What You Will Do

  • High-Volume Sourcing: Execute rapid hiring cycles (e.g., sourcing 50-100 freelance data annotators/speakers within days) using traditional and non-traditional channels.
  • Grassroots Traffic Generation: Dive deep into localized social media (Facebook groups, WhatsApp/Telegram communities), university forums, and regional gig-economy platforms to attract flexible workers.
  • Micro-Vendor Networking: Identify and build partnerships with local BPO agencies, small translation studios, or university student unions to act as our talent sub-nodes.
  • Fast-Paced Screening: Pre-screen large volumes of candidates for language proficiency and project availability, ensuring a seamless handover to our global delivery team.


Who You Are

  • Experience: You have a proven track record in Volume Hiring, BPO Recruitment, or Crowd-sourcing operations (experience with high-turnover/gig-worker recruitment is highly preferred).
  • Mindset: You are a \"hands-on\" executioner, not just a strategist. You thrive in a fast-paced, high-throughput environment and aren't afraid of the grind of mass hiring.
  • Language: Bilingual in English and Portuguese (Spanish is a strong plus for covering LATAM).
  • Prefered Setup: Established as an Independent Contractor with a registered PJ entity in Brazil.
  • Autonomy: Comfortable working remotely and asynchronously with our Global HQ.

Desenvolvedor Java Sênior - Vulnerabilidade


Responsabilidades:

  • Identificar, analisar e corrigir vulnerabilidades em projetos Java legado.

title: Creative Strategist
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Creative Strategist em feira de santana. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

We are a leading brand in health supplements for women over 40. Our mission is to improve the quality of life for women going through menopause by solving real, everyday challenges—weight gain, hot flashes, insomnia, mood shifts, and more.


We’re looking for a Creative Strategist with strong persuasive advertising and copywriting expertise to own the ideation and messaging that drives performance. You’ll turn customer insights, performance data, and market awareness into high-converting creative angles, scripts, and messaging systems that scale.


Responsibilities

Creative Strategy

  • Contribute to the development of creative strategy for paid social, grounded in direct-response principles
  • Translate performance data, customer research, and competitive insights into effective copy frameworks and angles
  • Support the creation of ad concepts and scalable creative approaches
  • Participate in brainstorming and help shape a testing roadmap of angles, messages, and formats based on clear hypotheses
  • Help maintain creative standards to ensure consistent brand voice and persuasive quality across ads, landing pages, and funnels


Performance & Media Buying Integration

  • Use platform learnings and audience behavior to shape creative testing and copy direction.
  • Build feedback loops so creative evolves weekly based on performance data across ads


AI & Creative Innovation

  • Experience leveraging AI tools to accelerate creative research and performance testing.
  • Proven ability to prepare structured briefs and prompts for AI-generated ad creatives (scripts, hooks, visuals, UGC-style ads).


Qualifications

  • Experience in creative strategy, performance creative, or e-commerce marketing.
  • Hands-on experience with direct-response copywriting
  • Direct experience with women’s wellness, supplements, or health-related products strongly preferred.
  • Proven ability to prepare structured briefs/prompts for AI-generated ad creatives (e.g., scripts, hooks, visuals, UGC-style ads).
  • Strong portfolio of paid social creative with proven ROI.
  • Excellent communication and cross-functional collaboration skills.


Working hours

  • 6am - 2pm EST (Monday - Friday)
  • Fully-remote


Compensation

  • $3,500 to $5,000/month


If you think you might be a good fit, please apply.

title: Desenvolvedor AEM, Senior
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Desenvolvedor AEM, Senior em lauro de freitas. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Who Are We.


Newfold Digital is a leading web technology company serving nearly seven million customers globally. Established in 2021 through the combination of leading web services providers Endurance Web Presence and Web.com Group, our portfolio of brands includes: Bluehost, BigRock, ResellerClub, CrazyDomains, HostGator, Network Solutions, Register.com, Web.com and many others.


We help customers of all sizes build a digital presence that delivers results. With our extensive product offerings and personalized support, we take pride in collaborating with our customers to serve their online presence needs.


What you’ll do & how you’ll make your mark.

  • Develop and maintain reusable front-end components in Adobe Experience Manager (AEM).
  • Work with AEM components and templates, including integrating front-end code with AEM's rendering system.
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams, including designers, back-end developers to deliver digital experiences.


Who you are & what you’ll need to succeed.

  • Advanced English skills .
  • Strong proficiency in HTML5, CSS3, JavaScript/TypeScript, and responsive web design principles.
  • Experience integrating Front-end code with AEM components, templates, and workflows.
  • Familiarity with AEM Sightly (HTL) and Sling models and AEM ecosystem.
  • Excellent communication skills and ability to collaborate effectively in a team environment.


Why you'll love us

  • We offer a 100% remote position with a monthly home office allowance of R$180.00 and an additional allowance for purchasing items for your office.
  • We provide Meal Vouchers or Food Vouchers worth R$44.55 per working day.
  • Health and dental insurance with no co-payment for employees.
  • Well-being program: Gympass, online meditation, and telemedicine!
  • Do you have a dog, cat, rabbit, hamster, goat, turtle, or even a mini dragon? We have a partnership for pet health insurance!
  • Educational platform: you can pursue undergraduate and graduate degrees, language courses (and much more!) at over 100 educational institutions for a very affordable price!
  • Life insurance.
  • Free website hosting.

title: Coordenação de dados IA
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Coordenação de dados IA em camaçari. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Liderar o desenvolvimento e a implementação de soluções de inteligência artificial, garantindo a inovação e a excelência técnica.


Responsabilidades:


* Projetar, desenvolver e implementar arquiteturas e soluções de IA escaláveis e de alto desempenho.

* Liderar e mentorar uma equipe de dados, promovendo um ambiente de colaboração e aprendizado.

* Definir e aplicar as melhores práticas de engenharia de software e princípios de MLOps.

* Discutir a arquitetura geral de dados, incluindo armazenamento de dados, data lake, processos ETL/ELT e estruturas de governança de dados, considerando a escala ideal e o tempo de lançamento no mercado.

* Colaborar com equipes multifuncionais para identificar oportunidades de aplicação de IA e traduzir requisitos de negócios em soluções técnicas.

* Projetar, desenvolver e manter pipelines de dados escalonáveis e confiáveis usando tecnologias apropriadas (por exemplo, Python, SQL, Spark, Kafka).

* Realizar pesquisa e avaliação de novas tecnologias e ferramentas de IA para impulsionar a inovação.

* Garantir a qualidade, segurança e conformidade das soluções de IA desenvolvidas.

* Monitorar e otimizar o desempenho de modelos e sistemas de IA em produção.

* Participar ativamente da estratégia de tecnologia da empresa, representando a área de IA.

* Avaliar e recomendar novas tecnologias, processos e ferramentas para aprimorar e acelerar nossos componentes e capacidades de dados.

* Solucionar problemas e resolver problemas complexos relacionados a dados, otimizando o desempenho e a confiabilidade.

* Manter-se atualizado com as tendências do setor e os avanços em tecnologias e metodologias de dados.

* Contribuir para o planejamento estratégico de iniciativas de dados e roadmap de dados de longo prazo.


Qualificações:


* Mínimo de 5 anos de experiência em ciência de dados, arquitetura de dados ou função semelhante com foco em dados, com pelo menos 2 anos em capacidade de liderança técnica.

* Experiência comprovada em liderança técnica e desenvolvimento de soluções de IA.

* Sólidos conhecimentos em machine learning, deep learning, processamento de linguagem natural (PNL) e visão computacional.

* Proficiência em linguagens de programação como Python e frameworks de IA (ex: TensorFlow, PyTorch).

* Experiência com plataformas de nuvem (AWS, Azure, GCP), Databricks e ferramentas de MLOps.

* Familiaridade com metodologias ágeis de desenvolvimento de software.

* Capacidade de comunicação clara e eficaz, tanto em português quanto em inglês.

* Formação superior em Ciência da Computação, Engenharia de Software, Inteligência Artificial ou área correlata.

* Forte pensamento analítico e capacidade de resolução de problemas complexos.

title: Desenvolvedor front-end SR
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Desenvolvedor front-end SR em lauro de freitas. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Desenvolvedor(a) Front-end Sênior | React + Mobile Híbrido


Buscamos um(a) Desenvolvedor(a) Front-end Sênior para atuar em projetos estratégicos de grande escala, com foco no desenvolvimento de experiências digitais modernas, performáticas e integradas aos ecossistemas mobile Android e iOS.


Buscamos profissionais que possuam sólida experiência em React e que tenham atuado em aplicações híbridas, compreendendo os desafios da integração entre aplicações web e componentes nativos mobile.


Principais Responsabilidades

Desenvolver e evoluir aplicações Front-end utilizando React e TypeScript.

Construir interfaces modernas, escaláveis e com alta preocupação em performance e usabilidade.

Atuar na integração entre aplicações React e ambientes mobile por meio de WebViews.

Trabalhar em conjunto com equipes Android e iOS para implementação de funcionalidades e resolução de problemas de integração.

Participar de definições arquiteturais, revisões de código e disseminação de boas práticas de desenvolvimento.

Garantir qualidade de código por meio de testes, monitoramento e observabilidade.


Requisitos Obrigatórios

Experiência sólida como Desenvolvedor(a) Front-end Sênior.

Domínio de React, TypeScript e JavaScript moderno (ES6+).

Experiência com arquitetura de aplicações Front-end de grande porte.

Conhecimento em consumo e integração de APIs REST.

Vivência com testes automatizados e boas práticas de desenvolvimento.

Experiência com Git e metodologias ágeis.


Diferenciais Importantes

Experiência com aplicações híbridas utilizando WebView.

Conhecimento sobre comunicação entre JavaScript e código nativo.

Vivência com Android (Kotlin/Java) e iOS (Swift), especialmente em cenários de integração com aplicações web.

Conhecimento de Design Systems, bibliotecas de componentes corporativas e padrões de desenvolvimento em larga escala.

Experiência em instituições financeiras, fintechs, bancos digitais ou empresas com grande volume transacional.

Desejável conhecimento em ambientes financeiros.

title: Engenheiro de dados S
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Engenheiro de dados S em camaçari. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Quem Somos

A Dexian, lançada em 2023, tem presença global e traz consigo quase 30 anos de experiência através de suas companhias legadas, principalmente da combinação da DISYS e Signature Consultants.


Iniciamos no Brasil 2007 como DISYS e, de lá para cá, conquistamos mais de 50 clientes de diferentes setores da economia. Como Dexian, passamos a ser uma das maiores empresas de contratação e solução de TI e estamos liderando a indústria por meio de entrega de serviços exclusivos que combina escala global, recursos de serviço completo e agilidade tática para modernizar modelos de contratação, avançar em soluções de mão-de-obra e transformar a infraestrutura tecnológica. Contamos com escritórios estrategicamente localizados em quatro grandes capitais: Curitiba (PR), Porto Alegre (RS), Rio de Janeiro (RJ) e São Paulo (SP). Assim, conseguimos nos manter próximos dos nossos clientes e consultores. Também somos uma Minority Owner Company e nos sentimos orgulhosos de termos nascido na diversidade.


O que esperar de nós

Pessoas estão no centro de nossa estratégia e compõem o nosso maior capital. Temos compromisso de atrair, reter os maiores e melhores talentos e construir conexões reais para a vida. Por isso, atuamos como ponte entre profissionais altamente qualificados e oportunidades consistentes e prósperas. Acreditamos que, trazer o talento, a tecnologia e as organizações certas juntos, ajuda a desbloquear resultados transformadores e alcançar novos níveis de sucessos para os clientes que atendemos e os consultores que contratamos. E para isso, cinco valores fundamentais nos guiam: Integridade, Transparência, Autenticidade, Engenhosidade e Empatia. Compartilha dos mesmos valores, aqui é seu lugar! Que tal desenvolver sua carreira conosco?


Na Dexian, valorizamos a diversidade.

Acreditamos que diferentes perspectivas, experiências e trajetórias impulsionam a inovação e fortalecem conexões. Por isso, nosso processo de contratação é inclusivo, aberto a candidatos de todas as identidades, habilidades e histórias. Aqui, o que importa é o talento.


Sobre a posição

Como parte de uma equipe global de tecnologia, o(a) Engenheiro(a) de Dados Sênior atuará no desenvolvimento, manutenção e evolução de produtos de dados em ambiente Cloud. O profissional será responsável por projetar e implementar soluções de engenharia de dados, garantindo qualidade, confiabilidade e escalabilidade dos dados utilizados pela organização.


A posição exige forte atuação em projetos de dados utilizando plataformas como Azure e Snowflake, além de colaboração constante com arquitetos, times ágeis e stakeholders de negócio para entrega de soluções analíticas de alto valor.


Principais Responsabilidades

• Projetar, desenvolver e manter soluções de engenharia de dados em ambiente Cloud.

• Desenvolver pipelines de dados batch e streaming utilizando plataformas Azure e Snowflake.

• Implementar processos de extração, transformação e carga de dados (ETL/ELT) provenientes de múltiplas fontes.

• Garantir a qualidade, governança e integridade dos dados ao longo de todo o ciclo de processamento.

• Desenvolver e manter soluções utilizando Snowflake, dbt e tecnologias do ecossistema Azure.

• Construir e otimizar consultas SQL, procedures e rotinas de processamento de dados.

• Implementar integrações entre diferentes sistemas e fontes de dados corporativas.

• Participar de provas de conceito (POCs), avaliações técnicas e demonstrações de novas tecnologias.

Colaboração e Entrega de Projetos

• Trabalhar em conjunto com equipes de negócio, arquitetos de soluções e times técnicos para levantamento de requisitos e definição de soluções.

• Traduzir necessidades de negócio em modelos de dados, fluxos automatizados e soluções escaláveis.

• Garantir aderência às melhores práticas de arquitetura, desenvolvimento, governança e segurança de dados.

• Participar ativamente de cerimônias ágeis e processos de melhoria contínua.

DevOps e Qualidade

• Atuar seguindo práticas de CI/CD, DevOps e padrões de desenvolvimento estabelecidos pela organização.

• Utilizar ferramentas de versionamento e gestão de código-fonte, como GitHub e Azure DevOps.

• Apoiar processos de automação, testes e monitoramento das soluções desenvolvidas.

• Contribuir para a evolução contínua da plataforma de dados e das práticas de engenharia adotadas pela equipe.


Requisitos Obrigatórios

• Experiência sólida em Engenharia de Dados (mínimo de 5 anos).

• Experiência prática com Snowflake.

• Conhecimento sólido em SQL, incluindo consultas complexas e stored procedures.

• Conhecimento sólido em dbt (Data Build Tool).

• Experiência na construção e manutenção de pipelines ETL/ELT em ambiente Cloud.

• Experiência com serviços Azure, incluindo ADF, Functions, Event Hub e Azure DevOps.

• Conhecimento em Python para desenvolvimento e automação de processos de dados.

• Conhecimento de modelagem de dados

• Experiência com práticas de CI/CD, DevOps e versionamento de código utilizando GitHub.

• Conhecimento em metodologias ágeis (Scrum e/ou Kanban).

• Inglês avançado para comunicação em ambiente corporativo global.

Diferenciais

• Experiência com ferramentas de replicação de dados, como Qlik Replicate, SLT ou Click.

• Experiência em projetos de Data & Analytics.

• Conhecimento em SQL Server e otimização de consultas.

• Conhecimento em ferramentas de visualização de dados, como Power BI ou Tableau será um diferencial.

• Experiência com plataformas de streaming de dados, como Kafka.

Cint is a global software leader in technology-enabled digital insights and research technology. The Cint platform automates the insights-gathering process so that companies can gain access to insights faster with unparalleled scale. Cint has one of the world’s largest consumer networks for digital survey-based research, made up of over 239 million engaged respondents across more than 130 countries. The Cint Technology team is looking for a Senior Software Engineer II to join our international Measurement team. This position is for a software engineer who likes challenges. Our business has been doubling in the last few years, and so our systems need to scale to accommodate this growth.

Our ideal candidate considers themselves among the highly technical and likes to push the limits of their knowledge and experience every day. In this role, you will work on designing, implementing, scaling, and maintaining the code that powers our production systems. With great freedom to innovate, you will play a key role in world-class research building the next generation of Cint products.

title: Creative Strategist
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Creative Strategist em salvador. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

We are a leading brand in health supplements for women over 40. Our mission is to improve the quality of life for women going through menopause by solving real, everyday challenges—weight gain, hot flashes, insomnia, mood shifts, and more.


We’re looking for a Creative Strategist with strong persuasive advertising and copywriting expertise to own the ideation and messaging that drives performance. You’ll turn customer insights, performance data, and market awareness into high-converting creative angles, scripts, and messaging systems that scale.


Responsibilities

Creative Strategy

  • Contribute to the development of creative strategy for paid social, grounded in direct-response principles
  • Translate performance data, customer research, and competitive insights into effective copy frameworks and angles
  • Support the creation of ad concepts and scalable creative approaches
  • Participate in brainstorming and help shape a testing roadmap of angles, messages, and formats based on clear hypotheses
  • Help maintain creative standards to ensure consistent brand voice and persuasive quality across ads, landing pages, and funnels


Performance & Media Buying Integration

  • Use platform learnings and audience behavior to shape creative testing and copy direction.
  • Build feedback loops so creative evolves weekly based on performance data across ads


AI & Creative Innovation

  • Experience leveraging AI tools to accelerate creative research and performance testing.
  • Proven ability to prepare structured briefs and prompts for AI-generated ad creatives (scripts, hooks, visuals, UGC-style ads).


Qualifications

  • Experience in creative strategy, performance creative, or e-commerce marketing.
  • Hands-on experience with direct-response copywriting
  • Direct experience with women’s wellness, supplements, or health-related products strongly preferred.
  • Proven ability to prepare structured briefs/prompts for AI-generated ad creatives (e.g., scripts, hooks, visuals, UGC-style ads).
  • Strong portfolio of paid social creative with proven ROI.
  • Excellent communication and cross-functional collaboration skills.


Working hours

  • 6am - 2pm EST (Monday - Friday)
  • Fully-remote


Compensation

  • $3,500 to $5,000/month


If you think you might be a good fit, please apply.

title: Engenheiro de dados S
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Engenheiro de dados S em feira de santana. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Quem Somos

A Dexian, lançada em 2023, tem presença global e traz consigo quase 30 anos de experiência através de suas companhias legadas, principalmente da combinação da DISYS e Signature Consultants.


Iniciamos no Brasil 2007 como DISYS e, de lá para cá, conquistamos mais de 50 clientes de diferentes setores da economia. Como Dexian, passamos a ser uma das maiores empresas de contratação e solução de TI e estamos liderando a indústria por meio de entrega de serviços exclusivos que combina escala global, recursos de serviço completo e agilidade tática para modernizar modelos de contratação, avançar em soluções de mão-de-obra e transformar a infraestrutura tecnológica. Contamos com escritórios estrategicamente localizados em quatro grandes capitais: Curitiba (PR), Porto Alegre (RS), Rio de Janeiro (RJ) e São Paulo (SP). Assim, conseguimos nos manter próximos dos nossos clientes e consultores. Também somos uma Minority Owner Company e nos sentimos orgulhosos de termos nascido na diversidade.


O que esperar de nós

Pessoas estão no centro de nossa estratégia e compõem o nosso maior capital. Temos compromisso de atrair, reter os maiores e melhores talentos e construir conexões reais para a vida. Por isso, atuamos como ponte entre profissionais altamente qualificados e oportunidades consistentes e prósperas. Acreditamos que, trazer o talento, a tecnologia e as organizações certas juntos, ajuda a desbloquear resultados transformadores e alcançar novos níveis de sucessos para os clientes que atendemos e os consultores que contratamos. E para isso, cinco valores fundamentais nos guiam: Integridade, Transparência, Autenticidade, Engenhosidade e Empatia. Compartilha dos mesmos valores, aqui é seu lugar! Que tal desenvolver sua carreira conosco?


Na Dexian, valorizamos a diversidade.

Acreditamos que diferentes perspectivas, experiências e trajetórias impulsionam a inovação e fortalecem conexões. Por isso, nosso processo de contratação é inclusivo, aberto a candidatos de todas as identidades, habilidades e histórias. Aqui, o que importa é o talento.


Sobre a posição

Como parte de uma equipe global de tecnologia, o(a) Engenheiro(a) de Dados Sênior atuará no desenvolvimento, manutenção e evolução de produtos de dados em ambiente Cloud. O profissional será responsável por projetar e implementar soluções de engenharia de dados, garantindo qualidade, confiabilidade e escalabilidade dos dados utilizados pela organização.


A posição exige forte atuação em projetos de dados utilizando plataformas como Azure e Snowflake, além de colaboração constante com arquitetos, times ágeis e stakeholders de negócio para entrega de soluções analíticas de alto valor.


Principais Responsabilidades

• Projetar, desenvolver e manter soluções de engenharia de dados em ambiente Cloud.

• Desenvolver pipelines de dados batch e streaming utilizando plataformas Azure e Snowflake.

• Implementar processos de extração, transformação e carga de dados (ETL/ELT) provenientes de múltiplas fontes.

• Garantir a qualidade, governança e integridade dos dados ao longo de todo o ciclo de processamento.

• Desenvolver e manter soluções utilizando Snowflake, dbt e tecnologias do ecossistema Azure.

• Construir e otimizar consultas SQL, procedures e rotinas de processamento de dados.

• Implementar integrações entre diferentes sistemas e fontes de dados corporativas.

• Participar de provas de conceito (POCs), avaliações técnicas e demonstrações de novas tecnologias.

Colaboração e Entrega de Projetos

• Trabalhar em conjunto com equipes de negócio, arquitetos de soluções e times técnicos para levantamento de requisitos e definição de soluções.

• Traduzir necessidades de negócio em modelos de dados, fluxos automatizados e soluções escaláveis.

• Garantir aderência às melhores práticas de arquitetura, desenvolvimento, governança e segurança de dados.

• Participar ativamente de cerimônias ágeis e processos de melhoria contínua.

DevOps e Qualidade

• Atuar seguindo práticas de CI/CD, DevOps e padrões de desenvolvimento estabelecidos pela organização.

• Utilizar ferramentas de versionamento e gestão de código-fonte, como GitHub e Azure DevOps.

• Apoiar processos de automação, testes e monitoramento das soluções desenvolvidas.

• Contribuir para a evolução contínua da plataforma de dados e das práticas de engenharia adotadas pela equipe.


Requisitos Obrigatórios

• Experiência sólida em Engenharia de Dados (mínimo de 5 anos).

• Experiência prática com Snowflake.

• Conhecimento sólido em SQL, incluindo consultas complexas e stored procedures.

• Conhecimento sólido em dbt (Data Build Tool).

• Experiência na construção e manutenção de pipelines ETL/ELT em ambiente Cloud.

• Experiência com serviços Azure, incluindo ADF, Functions, Event Hub e Azure DevOps.

• Conhecimento em Python para desenvolvimento e automação de processos de dados.

• Conhecimento de modelagem de dados

• Experiência com práticas de CI/CD, DevOps e versionamento de código utilizando GitHub.

• Conhecimento em metodologias ágeis (Scrum e/ou Kanban).

• Inglês avançado para comunicação em ambiente corporativo global.

Diferenciais

• Experiência com ferramentas de replicação de dados, como Qlik Replicate, SLT ou Click.

• Experiência em projetos de Data & Analytics.

• Conhecimento em SQL Server e otimização de consultas.

• Conhecimento em ferramentas de visualização de dados, como Power BI ou Tableau será um diferencial.

• Experiência com plataformas de streaming de dados, como Kafka.
